description: Header file defining log formatter classes and metric value formatters for ocudulog logging system.

classes.name: log_formatter
classes.description: Abstract base class for formatting log entries and contexts in various formats.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Returns a copy of the formatter.

methods.name: format_full_queue_error
methods.description: Formats a full queue error string into the buffer.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats a log entry into the buffer.

methods.name: format_ctx
methods.description: Formats context and log entry into the buffer, handling nested structures.

methods.name: iterate_tuple
methods.description: Processes all elements in a tuple for formatting.

methods.name: process_element
methods.description: Processes different metric elements (set, list, individual metric) for formatting.

methods.name: format_context_begin
methods.description: Callback for beginning of context formatting.

methods.name: format_context_end
methods.description: Callback for end of context formatting.

methods.name: format_metric_set_begin
methods.description: Callback for beginning of metric set formatting.

methods.name: format_metric_set_end
methods.description: Callback for end of metric set formatting.

methods.name: format_list_begin
methods.description: Callback for beginning of list formatting.

methods.name: format_list_end
methods.description: Callback for end of list formatting.
